title: Time windows, timezone, and configurable day start
description:
Purpose: parameterize the meter's time period with correct timezone and DST behavior.

Scope: a pure resolveWindow(spec, now, timezone, dayStart) function supporting rolling windows (last-24h, N hours, N days), calendar windows (today, yesterday) where the day starts at a configurable day-start time defaulting to local midnight, and absolute since/until bounds; wall-clock to UTC conversion via Intl timezone offsets with no new runtime dependencies; explicit DST rules (23h/25h days, spring-forward gap clamps forward, fall-back ambiguity resolves earlier).

Done when: window resolution is deterministic and pure; a message at 03:59 with day-start 04:00 falls in yesterday's window and one at 04:00:00 falls in today's; the pinned test matrix (UTC, America/Los_Angeles incl. DST transition dates, Asia/Tokyo, Australia/Lord_Howe, day-start 00:00/04:00/23:30) passes; per-source timestamp parsing (ISO-Z, epoch milliseconds, RFC3339) is normalized and tested.

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text: Epic complete: window resolution is deterministic and pure, the pinned matrix passes in Jest, and per-source timestamp normalization (from epic A) feeds the filter.
